title: research: independently verify complex root address partition
body:
The original PR3385 fast-root fixture has unit spacing, zero residue, no spectators, one field/outer row and no added rows. This package independently checks the joined internal address boundary with nontrivial spacing, spectators, multiple fields/rows and per-prefix padding from sixteen to eighteen rows.

The conditional proof derives the exact three-way selected-axis partition and row serialization, preserving the original leaf/recursive endpoints and ownership assumptions. The unchanged root descriptor methods, encoded Counts, row padding and transfers execute against declared permutation endpoint doubles. Two fixtures route 40,960 distinct coordinate records and check all 14 recursive descriptors; six negative controls reject. These are layout witnesses, not C arithmetic or production parameter fixtures. The original source already states the tensor split and padding-factor argument; this adds independent source binding and combined coverage.

Adversarial review caught a reversed-residue convention in the initial test oracle. The retained verifier corrects it and directly checks the inherited `Layout.bit_position` conversion for both leaves, the core and the original address, distinguishing the opposite residue.

Validation: both registered CPython 3.12.15 commands, including isolated optimized warnings-as-errors; metadata and committed-byte/source-history checks; all eleven controller inputs compared with original PR3385 Git bytes. All 47 live inputs are declared for invalidation. No recursive/native arithmetic, normalization/truncation proof, production `RootPlan.compute`, complete O73/GL64 execution, uniform invoice, changed T74 correctness or selected-frontier change is claimed.

Package: `research/complex-root-address-refinement`. Canonical coordination: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2238#discussioncomment-19014701

Credit Jose Manuel's PR3385 and retained source chain, Nick Petalas's PR3493 outer-format work, and Sagar Thakrar's PR3464 cohort setup/cleanup. Prepared with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance and separate same-session proof, implementation and adversarial-review agents. Not independent human acceptance or a formal kernel certificate.
